panels.description: Who calls whom, by service instance ID (by name for callers, Keycloak and databases). Built from two sources: edges from the PilotMcpServer instances come from their logs, which include Keycloak; the other edges come from Tempo's service graph. Edge numbers are calls. A caller with no span in Tempo is named from its User-Agent: Bruno, Browser (the Angular UI), or the raw User-Agent for anything else. Edges recorded before Tempo captured the User-Agent show it as `user`. Tempo edges recorded before the service graph carried instance IDs show service names.

sum by (id,source,target) (count_over_time({service_name="PilotMcpServer"} | label_format selected="$correlationId" | selected!="" | CorrelationId="$correlationId" or correlationId="$correlationId" |= "request handler completed" | label_format source="caller",target=`{{ .service_instance_id }}` | label_format id=`{{ .source }}->{{ .target }}` [$__auto]))

sum by (id,source,target) (count_over_time({service_instance_id=~".+"} | service_instance_id!~"pilot-mcp-server-.+" | label_format selected="$correlationId" | selected!="" | CorrelationId="$correlationId" or correlationId="$correlationId" | label_format source="caller",target=service_instance_id | label_format id=`{{ .source }}->{{ .target }}` [$__auto])) unless on() sum(count_over_time({service_name="PilotMcpServer"} | label_format selected="$correlationId" | selected!="" | CorrelationId="$correlationId" or correlationId="$correlationId" [1h]))
